lines.t: (Verse 1)
I almost turned around that day
Thought I had to be more.
I didn't know You welcomed those
Who were sick to Your door.
Thought I'd have to clean me up
Before I'd ever walk inside
But You met me where I was
With open arms and open eyes
(Pre-Chorus)
I thought I had to be perfect
Thought I had to earn Your grace
But You never asked for perfect
You just called my name
(Chorus)
All I got is just me
These worn-out boots and these worn-out dreams
A beat-up heart and these grass-stained jeans
I came with empty hands
Nothing good enough to give
I thought You wanted someone better
Someone stronger than I'd been
But You looked right through my brokenness
And still You wanted me
(Verse 2)
Some days my faith feels strong enough
Some days it barely stands
Still You're never letting go
Even when I let go of Your hand
You don't ask for polished words
Or a life that's all put right
You just ask me to come home
Just as I am tonight
(Chorus)
All I got is just me
These worn-out boots and these worn-out dreams
A beat-up heart and these grass-stained jeans
I came with empty hands
Nothing good enough to give
I thought You wanted someone better
Someone stronger than I'd been
But You looked right through my brokenness
And still You wanted me
(Bridge)
Then I finally saw it
You were never asking for perfect,
Just that I'd wanna come to You.
So here's every broken piece
Every fear I've tried to hide
'Cause You're the only One who can
Make this heart come back to life
(Final Chorus)
All I got is just me
These worn-out boots and these worn-out dreams
A beat-up heart and these grass-stained jeans
I came with empty hands
Nothing good enough to give
I thought You wanted someone better
Someone stronger than I'd been
But You looked right through my brokenness
And still You wanted me
